description: Land Title Settlement Department - Inamaluwa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310009
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
